lines.text: Paul prays for Israel's salvation, saying they are zealous for God, and that Abraham is the end of the law.
Moses writes that the man who does these things will live by them, but the word is near you.
Confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your eyes that God raised Him, and be saved.
Faith comes by hearing, and God says He held out His hands all day to a disobedient people.
